meta.label: fetch.py
meta.value:
"""Fetch FPL league data: game status, league standings and each team's gameweek history.
Usage: python3 fetch.py <data_dir> <league_id>
Picks and live points (only needed to break a tie) are fetched later by compute.py, on demand."""
import json, os, sys, time, urllib.request

data_dir, league_id = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
BASE = "https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api"


def get(path, cache):
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
                d = json.loads(r.read())
            break
        except Exception:
            if attempt == 3:
                raise
            time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1))
    json.dump(d, open(os.path.join(data_dir, cache), "w"))
    time.sleep(0.15)
    return d


os.makedirs(os.path.join(data_dir, "hist"), exist_ok=True)
boot = get("/bootstrap-static/", "bootstrap.json")
league = get(f"/leagues-classic/{league_id}/standings/", "league.json")
entries = [r["entry"] for r in league["standings"]["results"]]
for eid in entries:
    get(f"/entry/{eid}/history/", f"hist/{eid}.json")
finished = [e["id"] for e in boot["events"] if e["finished"] and e["data_checked"]]
print("entries", len(entries), "finished GWs", finished)

meta.label: compute.py
make_files.py
meta.value:
"""Turn league_data.json (from compute.py) into the dashboard's data files.
Usage: python3 -I make_files.py <league_data.json> <scripts_dir> <out_dir>
Each file is {rows, meta}; meta carries the code that made it."""
import json, os, sys

src, scripts_dir, out_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
d = json.load(open(src))
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

SEASON_PCT = [18, 10, 7, 6, 5, 4]
pot = d["pot"]
cur = d["current_gw"]                  # last GW that FPL has closed (prizes go by this)
show = d.get("show_gw") or cur         # GW the site shows: the in-progress one, if any
prov = d.get("provisional_gw")
mem = {m["entry"]: m for m in d["members"]}
name = lambda e: mem[e]["manager"]
fmt_names = lambda es: ", ".join(name(e) for e in es)

code = [{"label": fn, "value": open(os.path.join(scripts_dir, fn)).read(), "type": "code", "lang": "python"}
        for fn in ("fetch.py", "compute.py", "make_files.py")]
meta = code + [{"label": "Input", "value": f"FPL API, classic league {d['league_id']}, GW1–{show}"
                                           + (f" (GW{prov} provisional)" if prov else "")}]

# ---- special awards (projected leaders, split on ties) ----
award_share = {e: 0.0 for e in mem}
awards = []
for i, s in enumerate(d["season"][:6]):
    awards.append({"id": f"season{i+1}", "kind": "season", "name": f"อันดับ {i+1} จบฤดูกาล", "pct": SEASON_PCT[i],
                   "baht": pot * SEASON_PCT[i] / 100, "leader": name(s["entry"]), "value": s["total"],
                   "detail": f"{s['total']} แต้ม", "status": "ตัดสินแล้ว" if cur >= 38 else "ถ้าจบวันนี้"})

def special(aid, title, leaders, value, detail, status):
    prize = pot * 3 / 100
    for e in leaders:
        award_share[e] += prize / len(leaders)
    awards.append({"id": aid, "kind": "special", "name": title, "pct": 3, "baht": prize,
                   "leader": fmt_names(leaders) if leaders else None, "value": value,
                   "detail": detail, "status": status})

h1, h2 = d["half1"], d["half2"]
special("half1", "แชมป์ครึ่งฤดูกาลแรก (GW1–19)", h1["leaders"], h1["best"],
        f"{h1['best']} แต้ม" + (" (แบ่งกัน)" if len(h1["leaders"]) > 1 else ""),
        "ตัดสินแล้ว" if cur >= 19 else "นำอยู่")

if cur >= 20:
    s2 = {int(k): v for k, v in h2["scores"].items()}
    best = max(s2.values()); lead2 = [e for e, v in s2.items() if v == best]
    special("half2", "แชมป์ครึ่งฤดูกาลหลัง (GW20–38)", lead2, best, f"{best} แต้ม",
            "ตัดสินแล้ว" if cur >= 38 else "นำอยู่")
    s1 = {int(k): v for k, v in h1["scores"].items()}
    n2 = cur - 19
    # until GW38 the halves have different lengths, so compare per-GW averages
    imp = {e: (s2[e] / n2 - s1[e] / 19) if cur < 38 else (s2[e] - s1[e]) for e in s1}
    bi = max(imp.values()); lead_i = [e for e, v in imp.items() if abs(v - bi) < 1e-9]
    special("improve", "พัฒนาการดีที่สุด (19 วีกหลัง − 19 วีกแรก)", lead_i, round(bi, 1),
            (f"+{bi:.0f} แต้ม" if cur >= 38 else f"+{bi:.1f} แต้ม/วีก (เทียบค่าเฉลี่ย)"),
            "ตัดสินแล้ว" if cur >= 38 else "นำอยู่")
else:
    special("half2", "แชมป์ครึ่งฤดูกาลหลัง (GW20–38)", [], None, "เริ่มนับ GW20", "ยังไม่เริ่ม")
    special("improve", "พัฒนาการดีที่สุด (19 วีกหลัง − 19 วีกแรก)", [], None, "เริ่มวัดหลัง GW20", "ยังไม่เริ่ม")

gm = d["gwmax"]
gm_detail = ", ".join(f"GW{g}" for e in gm["leaders"] for g in gm["when"][str(e)])
special("gwmax", "แต้มสูงสุดใน 1 วีกของฤดูกาล", gm["leaders"], gm["best"], f"{gm['best']} แต้ม ({gm_detail})",
        "ตัดสินแล้ว" if cur >= 38 else "นำอยู่")

# ---- weekly winners (newest first) ----
weekly = []
for w in sorted(d["weeks"], key=lambda w: -w["gw"]):
    split = len(w["winners"])
    note = ""
    if len(w["tied"]) > 1:
        note = "เสมอ " + fmt_names(w["tied"]) + " → ตัดสินด้วย 15 ตัว/กัปตัน/รองกัปตัน/GK"
        if split > 1:
            note += " ยังเท่ากัน แบ่งรางวัล"
    weekly.append({"gw": w["gw"], "winner": fmt_names(w["winners"]),
                   "team": ", ".join(mem[e]["team"] for e in w["winners"]),
                   "winner_entry": ",".join(str(e) for e in w["winners"]),
                   "points": w["top"], "baht": pot / 100, "note": note or None})

# ---- standings ----
weekly_won = {int(k): v for k, v in d["weekly_won"].items()}
wins = {e: 0.0 for e in mem}
for w in d["weeks"]:
    for e in w["winners"]:
        wins[e] += 1 / len(w["winners"])
leader_total = d["season"][0]["total"]
standings = []
for s in d["season"]:
    e = s["entry"]
    proj = weekly_won[e] + s["projected"] + award_share[e]
    standings.append({"rank": s["rank"], "entry": e, "team": mem[e]["team"], "manager": mem[e]["manager"],
                      "total": s["total"], "gap": s["total"] - leader_total,
                      "gw_points": d["net"][str(e)].get(str(show), 0),
                      "weekly_wins": round(wins[e], 2), "weekly_baht": weekly_won[e],
                      "season_baht": s["projected"], "award_baht": award_share[e],
                      "projected_baht": proj, "gw": show,
                      "provisional": bool(prov), "final_gw": cur})

# ---- points per GW, wide (one column per GW) ----
scores = []
for s in d["season"]:
    e = s["entry"]
    row = {"entry": e, "manager": mem[e]["manager"], "team": mem[e]["team"]}
    for g in range(1, show + 1):
        row[f"GW{g}"] = d["net"][str(e)].get(str(g), 0)
    scores.append(row)

for fn, rows in [("standings", standings), ("weekly", weekly), ("awards", awards), ("scores", scores)]:
    json.dump({"rows": rows, "meta": meta}, open(os.path.join(out_dir, fn + ".json"), "w"), ensure_ascii=False)
assert abs(sum(a["pct"] for a in awards) + 38 - 100) < 1e-9
print("projected payout", sum(r["projected_baht"] for r in standings), "of pot", pot)
for r in standings:
    print(r["rank"], r["manager"], r["total"], r["gap"], r["weekly_baht"], r["season_baht"], r["award_baht"], r["projected_baht"])
